params.name: from_
params.description: From offset, used in pagination with default value 0

params.name: size
params.description: Number of result to fetch in search response from the offset. Default is 20 and maximum allowed is 100

params.name: types
params.description: Type of assets to search on like image,video,audio,folder,font,blob

params.name: constraints
params.description: Comma separated search filters in terms of field:value pair

params.name: attributes
params.description: Filters on custom_attributes.* fields. Input is passed as key value pair separated by ":" and more than one fields are separated by "#$!%#"

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Asset search results to be sorted based on. Input is passed as field:order pair separated by ":". More than one fields are separated by "#$!%#"

params.name: asset_attributes
params.description: Filters on asset_attributes.* fields. Input is passed as key value pair separated by ":" and more than one fields are separated by "#$!%#"

params.name: exclude_attributes
params.description: Execlude filters on asset_attributes.* fields. Input is passed as key value pair separated by ":" and more than one fields are separated by "#$!%#"

params.name: url_filter
params.description: Filter only those result which has asset url in it

params.name: exact_match
params.description: Whether to search only the query text or attribute values as well

params.name: path
params.description: Folder path to search assets in

params.name: exact_path
params.description: Whether to match exact path or not

params.name: show_hidden
params.description: Whether to include hidden assets in the search result or not

params.name: filesize_threshold
params.description: Filter on Asset size in KB

params.name: search_all
params.description: Whether to search on asset only or include folder results as well

params.name: offer
params.description: Offer text to search on asset_attributes.flag_offer field

params.name: source
params.description: Source of the search request for custom search handling
